title: Customer Case Study & Testimonial Films
description: Authentic, interview-led customer stories and peer testimonials that build unshakeable commercial trust and accelerate enterprise sales cycles.
seoTitle: Client Case Study Video Production | Cambridge & London
seoDescription: B2B customer case study films and client testimonials filmed across Cambridge and London. Authentic peer-proof videos that shorten sales cycles and win trust.
heroLead: Great partnerships speak for themselves. We film your clients in their workplace, capturing authentic voices while keeping their story in sync with your core messaging, translating real-world experience into your narrative.
breakdownBody: Great interviews happen when people feel comfortable. We keep our direction calm and supportive, whether having a relaxed discussion or using a prompter for scripted talking points. Your partners look composed and speak with natural confidence.

deliverables.title: The Core Customer Film (2–3 Mins)
deliverables.description: A cinematic documentary tracing the real-world challenge, technical deployment, and measurable results. We blend relaxed, conversational interviews with dynamic B-roll of your product, team, and customer facility in daily operation.

deliverables.title: Challenge-Specific Cutdowns (30–60s)
deliverables.description: Focused 30-to-60 second excerpts delivered in vertical (9:16) and widescreen formats with styled captions. Each clip isolates a single hurdle or commercial win, tailored for LinkedIn feeds and direct sales outreach.

deliverables.title: Production Stills & Verified Transcripts
deliverables.description: High-resolution photography of your partner in their workspace, delivered alongside timecoded transcripts and approved pull-quotes—giving your marketing team the exact collateral needed for written case studies, proposals, and press releases.

ctaDescription: We work alongside your team to make filming effortless for your partner.
